question: The length of a rectangle is 1 cm more than its width. Its perimeter is 14 cm. The area of the rectangle is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of Length and Width = Perimeter ÷ 2 = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 cm.

Difference between Length and Width is 1 cm.

Length = (7 + 1) ÷ 2 = 4 cm.

Width = (7 − 1) ÷ 2 = 3 cm.

Area = Length × Width = 4 × 3 = 12 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 Length (L) = W + 1
 L = 4 cm
 Width (W)
 W = 3 cm
 Area = L × W

**Given:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 14 cm

Length (L) = Width (W) + 1 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter = 2 × (L + W)

Area = L × W

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (W + 1 + W) = 14

⇒ 2W + 1 = 14 ÷ 2

⇒ 2W + 1 = 7

⇒ 2W = 6

⇒ W = 3 cm

⇒ L = 3 + 1 = 4 cm

⇒ Area = 4 × 3 = 12 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Rectangle

The region occupied by the rectangle is called its area. Area = Length × Width.

Perimeter of a Rectangle

The total length of the boundary of a rectangle is its perimeter. Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Width).

Diagonal of a Rectangle

The straight line connecting the opposite corners of the rectangle. Diagonal = √(Length² + Width²).
